study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Oliveira-Saraiva and Ferreira, Frontiers in Psychiatry, 2023
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative model detects abnormal functional connectivity in psychiatric disorders

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Autoencoder implemented using Keras. Architecture: three hidden layers (91-46-13-46-91). Activation: Leaky ReLU. Regularization: L2 (1e-5) and Dropout (0.5). Optimization: Adam.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Autoencoder was the selected architecture... It consisted of three hidden layers (91-46-13-46-91), with the activation function of the hidden layers being the leaky rectified linear unit.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: OliveiraSaraiva2023.pdf.md: Materials and methods / 2.4.2. Model training

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: ROI-based functional connectivity (Pearson correlation) between 14 functional brain networks (FBNs) from Shirer et al. (2012). The upper triangular part of the matrix (91 features) was used.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Pearson's correlation coefficients between the extracted blood oxygen level-dependent (BOLD) time series of all FBNs were calculated... transformed into a vector containing 91 features (pairs of FBNs) for feeding the normative model.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: OliveiraSaraiva2023.pdf.md: Materials and methods / 2.3. Functional brain connectivity

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The authors state that the model received no information about sex or age. No other covariates are mentioned as inputs to the autoencoder.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Fourthly, we started with a simple autoencoder that received no information about sex/age.
